feedback_text: Please add examples beside each evidence category for claims involving home nursing care.
The portal accepted my records after I divided one large file into three smaller files. It took extra time, but I completed the submission.
A drag-and-drop area would make it easier to attach several receipts from a laptop.
The occupation question offers employed or unemployed, but neither describes parental leave. Which option should I select?
The tracker says external review. Does that mean the clinic is reviewing the claim or your claims team?
My claim moved from awaiting decision back to received, with no explanation, after I had already waited two weeks.
Weekly email updates would be useful while a claim is being assessed.
The reimbursement arrived on schedule. The bank description was cryptic, but I could match it to my claim using the amount.
I could not sign in on my tablet, but the phone app worked, so I used it to submit the claim.
Please let adults on the same policy use separate profiles instead of sharing one login.
The chat displayed 'connection lost' while I waited, but the real setback was being placed at the end of the queue when I rejoined.
The app and website use different names for the same claim milestones. Nothing failed, but switching between them was confusing.
I would like one activity history that combines form edits, document submissions, claim-stage changes, and payments.
